messages:
elaine: Quick preflight — next week's launch + webinar :rocket: Need owners for: keywords, schema (Event JSON-LD), internal linking (launch posts -> funnel), and redirects/canonical. I sketched a tiny plan below.

devon: @elaine I can own redirects + canonical. Drop the exact old URLs and target pages and I'll write the 301s.

maria: I'll take keywords + align the benchmark narrative. Planning to bucket terms into top-level vs longtail so webinar copy maps to longtail.

sam: I’ll handle internal linking map and CTA wiring. Also confirm HubSpot form routing for webinar signups -> inbound funnel.

tyler: Infra note: need a deploy window for redirects (prefer 10pm PT) and any server-side canonical header changes. Happy to coordinate.

elaine: Awesome. Minimal mapping to start (we'll iterate):
- /products/inference -> "inference platform"
- /webinars/reliable-llm -> "low-latency LLM serving"
- /docs/dedicated -> "dedicated inference"
Benchmark narrative target: "cost-efficient inference" (longtail variants e.g., "reduce per-token inference cost").

devon: Redirect snippet (nginx style) — I'll adapt to our infra:```
# 301 old launch pages -> new canonical
rewrite ^/old-launch/(.*)$ /products/inference permanent;
rewrite ^/old-webinar/(.*)$ /webinars/reliable-llm permanent;
# fallback for legacy docs -> /docs
rewrite ^/docs/v1/(.*)$ /docs/$1 permanent;
```Please confirm the old paths list.

maria: Keyword buckets I'm starting with: ["LLM inference", "low-latency LLM serving", "dedicated inference", "inference cost optimization", "inference batching"]. Will generate meta title + 2 headline options per landing/webinar page by EOD.

sam: Internal linking quick plan:
- From blog launch posts: 2 contextual links to /products/inference (anchor: "inference platform", "low-latency inference")
- Webinar page -> hero CTA to /pricing?plan=inference (add UTM_source=webinar)
- Add mid-article link to benchmark narrative (anchor: "inference cost benchmark")
Also add canonical tags on blog templates to prefer the launch landing when duplicate.

seo-bot: quick crawl sim: found duplicate title at /blog/2023-llm-launch and /old-launch/overview -> recommend 301 + set rel=canonical to /products/inference. Also flagged missing Event schema on /webinars/reliable-llm.

maria: Schema snippet for webinar (JSON-LD) to add to page head. We'll update times and registration URL:```
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Reliable LLM at Scale: Launch + Benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2025-05-14T10:00:00-07:00",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.inference/webinars/reliable-llm" },
  "offers": { "@type": "Offer", "url": "https://redwood.inference/webinars/reliable-llm/register" }
}
</script>
```That should help SERP rich results.

tyler: Deployment notes: I'll queue redirects during the 10pm PT window. @devon ping me with final nginx rules by 8pm PT so I can stage. Also confirm any CDN cache invalidation — we should purge the HTML for affected paths.

devon: Will do. I'll compile final list now: `/old-launch/overview`, `/old-launch/case-study`, `/blog/2023-llm-launch`. Target -> `/products/inference`.

sam: HubSpot form snippet — add hidden inputs for UTM + source for routing to correct list:```
<input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="webinar">
<input type="hidden" name="lead_source" value="webinar_register_2025-05">
```Make sure HubSpot form mapping picks up lead_source to assign lifecycle.

elaine: TL;DR owners + deadlines:
- Redirects & canonicals: @devon by 20:00 PT
- Deploy redirects & CDN purge: @tyler 22:00 PT deploy window
- Keywords + benchmark narrative mapping: @maria by EOD
- Internal linking + CTAs + UTMs: @sam by EOD
- Add Event JSON-LD to webinar page: @maria (or ping eng to ship) by EOD

maria: I'll also run a quick SERP check for the keyword buckets and post the top-3 competitor titles in this thread.

sam: got it — will add anchor map in Google Sheet and tag pages to update.

seo-bot: scheduled crawl job for tomorrow 06:00 PT to verify 301s and schema — will post results here.

elaine: Perfect. Thanks everyone — small, focused sprint. If anyone finds other legacy pages, drop them here and @devon will add to the list. :sparkles:
